lab.name: Lallemand
lab.description: Global yeast producer. Brands: LalBrew (beer), Lalvin (wine/mead/cider), DistilaMax (spirits), WildBrew (non-conventional).

attribution: Specs transcribed from Lallemand Brewing, Lalvin, and DistilaMax published product data sheets.

strains.name: LalBrew Nottingham
strains.description: Neutral, versatile English ale strain; ferments cool and clean, popular as a low-cost workhorse.
strains.attribution: Attenuation, temperature range, flocculation and alcohol tolerance are transcribed from Lallemand's technical data sheet for this strain, read from the PDF. The sheet is cited rather than the product page: lallemandbrewing.com is a client-rendered app whose old /en/global/ product URLs now 404, and a TDS states the figures where a product page sells the sachet.

strains.name: Lalvin EC-1118
strains.description: The champagne workhorse; ferments dry, very high alcohol tolerance, fast, low foaming, great for restarting stuck ferments.

strains.name: Lalvin 71B-1122
strains.description: Metabolizes 20–40% of malic acid, softening high-acid fruit wines and meads; produces esters that soften young wines.

strains.name: Lalvin ICV-D47
strains.description: Côtes-du-Rhône strain; a mead-maker favorite for full mouthfeel and floral aromatics. Keep in tight temp range to avoid fusel/H2S.

strains.name: Lalvin K1V-1116
strains.description: Fast, robust 'killer' strain tolerant of low nutrients and wide temps; good for aromatic whites and difficult musts.

strains.name: Lalvin RC212
strains.description: Burgundy red strain; preserves color and fruit, good for lighter reds. High nutrient demand.

strains.name: DistilaMax RM
strains.description: Rum distilling strain selected for cane/molasses washes; heat tolerant, ester-forward.
strains.attribution: The cited page has gone: lallemandbiofuels.com no longer resolves at all - not a 404, no DNS. Lallemand's distilled-spirits business now trades as Lallemand Biofuels & Distilled Spirits at lallemandbds.com, but that host answers automated requests with 403, so its DistilaMax pages could not be retrieved and confirmed to be the right document. Rather than swap in a URL nobody has read, the dead one is recorded here and the figures stand on it.
